entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Varma,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. On 27.04.2023 this Court passed the following order:
"The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with the prayer to direct the District and Sessions Judge, Sambhal/ Moradabad to complete the enquiry in pursuance of the order/ letter dated 07.07.2017 of the Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Moradabad and further to direct the court below to recover the file of Case No. 283 of 2010, State v. Jitendra Sharma and others, arising out of Case Crime No. 1137 of 2007, under Sections 420, 409 I.P.C., Police Station Sambhal, District Moradabad Sudesh Kumar Tyagi vs State Of U.P. And 5 Others on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/80042561/
1 (now Sambhal) pending in the Court of the Judicial Magistrate, Sambhal and also to direct to conclude the trial within stipulated period.

entities.label: COURT

entities.text: State v. Jitendra Sharma and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Police Station Sambhal, District Moradabad Sudesh Kumar Tyagi vs State Of U.P. And 5 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Court of the Judicial Magistrate, Sambhal
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
It is submitted that pursuant to an application filed by the applicant under Section 156 (3) Cr.P.C. a first information report was lodged against the opposite party nos. 2 to 6 on 03.12.2007, registered as Case Crime No. 1137 of 2007, under Sections 420,
467, 471, 406, 323, 342 I.P.C., Police Station Sambhal, District Moradabad.
In the said case after investigation, charge-sheet has been submitted.
The Court concerned on 22.09.2008 summoned the opposite party no. 2.

It is further submitted that this Court vide order dated 14.10.2009 passed in Application U/S 482 No. 26452 of 2009, Sudesh Kumar Tyagi v. State of U.P.,
directed the court concerned to decide the pending trial as expeditiously as possible,
preferably within six months from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this order.

entities.text: Sudesh Kumar Tyagi v. State of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is contended that despite service of order of this Court, the proceedings of the case has remained pending.
In this regard, reference has also been placed upon the order dated 18.04.2017 passed by the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Moradabad.
It is also contended that after the bifurcation of the District Moradabad the district Sambhal is having jurisdiction to proceed with the case.
Let a report be submitted by the District Judge, Sambhal regarding status of the proceedings of the aforesaid case.

Place this case as fresh on 22.05.2023 along with the report of the District Judge,
Sambhal.

A copy of this order be sent to the District Judge, Sambhal for compliance through the Registrar (Compliance) within a week."
3.
In compliance with the aforesaid order, the District Judge, Sambhal at Chandausi has sent his report dated 20.05.2023, which has been placed on the record.

As per the report of the District Judge, Sambhal at Chandausi, the next date fixed in the trial is 30.05.2023, the accused are not appearing before the trial Court and as such, coercive measures are being adopted for their appearance.
4. The Court concerned has also recorded that pursuant to the earlier order passed by this Court the trial shall be concluded expeditiously.
5. In view thereof, no further order needs to be passed by this court.
Accordingly, the application is consigned to record.

Order Date :- 22.5.2023 SKT/-
